network.note: Each sample is the time from opening a TCP connection to the stats service on the engine's machine until the connection is established, which takes one network round trip. The stats service is a separate process from the engine, so the probe costs the engine nothing, and the harness takes the samples before the engine starts its tracks.

engine.name: typesense
engine.keyword_setup: Not BM25; the harness creates the text field with locale `en` and `stem` enabled, applies the Lucene English stop words the BM25 engines analyze with, sets `drop_tokens_threshold` to the number of results requested so a long question drops words until that many documents match, sorts by `_text_match`, and leaves every other setting at its default

engine_memory.source: engine container cgroup memory.current and memory.stat anon, sampled every 0.25 s through each track
